Putco's Boss Grille for Jeep Wrangler JK is made from 20% heavier gauge stainless aluminum material. The unique styling is tailored to the Jeep brand and is simple to install. This Grille is covered by Putco's NeveRust Lifetime Warranty. The hidden mounting system means no exposed bolt heads. Make your Jeep look like "The Boss" with Putco's Boss Grille!!

Made in the USA!
